title: Expansion of binary compact-support tower comparisons on a fixed staircase
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring. Work with constant-$A$ module sheaves on the small etale sites and their unbounded derived categories $D(S_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. All schemes below are Noetherian, meaning they admit finite affine covers by spectra of Noetherian rings [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Suppose given open immersions [def-weil-open-immersion]
$$X\xrightarrow{l}U\xrightarrow{a}V\xrightarrow{b}\overline X,\qquad Y\xrightarrow{d}W\xrightarrow{k}\overline Y,\qquad Z\xrightarrow{i}\overline Z,$$
and proper maps [def-weil-proper-morphism]
$$m:U\to Y,\quad r:V\to W,\quad p:\overline X\to\overline Y,\quad q:W\to Z,\quad s:\overline Y\to\overline Z,\quad t:\overline Z\to T.$$
Assume $ra=dm$, $pb=kr$, and $sk=iq$, and that the three corresponding squares $Q_A=(a,m,r,d)$, $Q_B=(b,r,p,k)$, $Q_C=(k,q,s,i)$ are cartesian [def-pc-fibre-product]. Put $f=ml:X\to Y$, $g=qd:Y\to Z$ and $h=ti:Z\to T$. Use the compact-support candidates $F_{(j,u)}=Ru_*Dj_!$ [def-amb-etale-compact-support], where $Dj_!$ is degreewise extension by zero and $Ru_*$ is unbounded derived direct image. For any such proper/open tower, define its raw binary comparison $\Theta$ by applying the outer proper direct image to the specified interchange $\Gamma:Di_!Rq_*\to Rp_*Db_!$ of [lem-amb-unbounded-proper-open-interchange], whiskering by the inner open extension, and then using direct-image and open-extension composition [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition, lem-cbc-extension-zero-composition]. This definition uses only the displayed candidates, without compactification independence or any associativity assertion for $\Theta$.

Set $\mathsf A=\Gamma_{Q_A}:Dd_!Rm_*\to Rr_*Da_!$, $\mathsf B=\Gamma_{Q_B}:Dk_!Rr_*\to Rp_*Db_!$, and $\mathsf C=\Gamma_{Q_C}:Di_!Rq_*\to Rs_*Dk_!$. Use the candidates
$$F_f=Rm_*Dl_!,\quad F_g=Rq_*Dd_!,\quad F_h=Rt_*Di_!,$$
$$F_{gf}=R(qr)_*D(al)_!,\quad F_{hg}=R(ts)_*D(kd)_!,\quad F_{hgf}=R(tsp)_*D(bal)_!.$$
The binary comparisons for $(g,f),(h,g),(h,gf),(hg,f)$ use respectively $Q_A,Q_C$, the vertical rectangle $Q_B+Q_C$, and the horizontal rectangle $Q_A+Q_B$. After inserting the indicated structural composition isomorphisms, the composite first comparing $(g,f)$ and then $(h,gf)$ is represented, from $Rt_*Di_!Rq_*Dd_!Rm_*Dl_!$ to $Rt_*Rs_*Rp_*Db_!Da_!Dl_!$, by
$$L=(Rt_*Rs_*\mathsf B Da_!Dl_!)\circ(Rt_*\mathsf C Rr_*Da_!Dl_!)\circ(Rt_*Di_!Rq_*\mathsf A Dl_!).$$
The composite first comparing $(h,g)$ and then $(hg,f)$ is represented, with the same source and target and the same structural identifications, by
$$R=(Rt_*Rs_*\mathsf B Da_!Dl_!)\circ(Rt_*Rs_*Dk_!\mathsf A Dl_!)\circ(Rt_*\mathsf C Dd_!Rm_*Dl_!).$$
These are expansion identities for the specified raw comparisons on this fixed staircase; they assert neither equality of $L$ and $R$ nor any independence of the staircase.

proof.text: By the definition of the raw binary comparison $\Theta$ in the statement, built on the candidates $F_{(j,u)}=Ru_*Dj_!$ of [def-amb-etale-compact-support], each binary comparison is obtained by applying the outer proper derived direct image to the corresponding proper/open interchange map of [lem-amb-unbounded-proper-open-interchange], whiskering by the inner degreewise open extension, and inserting the canonical direct-image and open-extension composition isomorphisms. The relevant squares are read off from the factorizations: for $(g,f)$ the interchange $Dd_!Rm_*\to Rr_*Da_!$ is that of $Q_A$; for $(h,g)$ the interchange $Di_!Rq_*\to Rs_*Dk_!$ is that of $Q_C$; for $(h,gf)$, with $gf=(qr)(al)$ (using $dm=ra$), the interchange $Di_!R(qr)_*\to R(sp)_*Db_!$ belongs to the square with top $b$, left $qr$, right $sp$, bottom $i$, which is $Q_B$ stacked over $Q_C$; for $(hg,f)$, with $hg=(ts)(kd)$ (using $iq=sk$), the interchange $D(kd)_!Rm_*\to Rp_*D(ba)_!$ belongs to the square with top $ba$, left $m$, right $p$, bottom $kd$, which is $Q_A$ placed left of $Q_B$. The composition isomorphisms identify the source of both iterated comparisons with $Rt_*Di_!Rq_*Dd_!Rm_*Dl_!$ (no composite occurs there) and the target $F_{hgf}$ with $Rt_*Rs_*Rp_*Db_!Da_!Dl_!$. The two routes produce the latter identification through different parenthesizations; they agree. For the open factors, $D(bal)_!\cong Db_!Da_!Dl_!$ is independent of the parenthesization by the three-fold compatibility clause of [lem-cbc-extension-zero-composition], applied degreewise. For the proper factors, let $I$ be K-injective on $\overline X$, choose K-injective resolutions $p_*I\to J$ and $s_*J\to K$, and a K-injective resolution $(sp)_*I\to J'$. By the normalization in [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition], $(Rt_*\kappa_{s,p})\circ\kappa_{t,sp}$ is represented by $t_*$ of $(sp)_*I\to J'\to K$, where $J'\to K$ is the homotopy class representing $\kappa_{s,p}$ [lem-weil-pbc-kinjective-hom-derived], hence by $t_*$ of $(sp)_*I=s_*p_*I\to s_*J\to K$; and $(\kappa_{t,s}Rp_*)\circ\kappa_{ts,p}$ is represented by $(ts)_*p_*I\to t_*s_*J\to t_*K$, the same map. So $R(tsp)_*\cong Rt_*Rs_*Rp_*$ is the same along both routes, and $L$ and $R$ below are taken with the same structural identifications.

proof.text: Apply the vertical and horizontal pasting identities for the specified interchange maps. With the structural composition isomorphisms suppressed as in the statement, vertical pasting gives $\Gamma_{Q_B+Q_C}=(R s_*\mathsf B)\circ(\mathsf C R r_*)$, while horizontal pasting gives $\Gamma_{Q_A+Q_B}=(\mathsf B D a_!)\circ(D k_!\mathsf A)$. Whiskering these equations by the remaining open extensions and proper direct images, and then composing with the first square map, expands the first parenthesization to the displayed composite $L$ and the second parenthesization to the displayed composite $R$.

proof.text: The preceding calculations are equalities of the specified raw comparison morphisms after the stated structural identifications. They establish the two expansion identities requested in the statement; they do not compare $L$ with $R$ and do not invoke compactification independence or an associativity assertion.
